method:
Record production checkpoint/participation at 30 Hz and 15 fps.

Only completed predecessor quests and initial player stations are fixtures.
Every route, contact, dialogue acknowledgment, optional response and return uses
Game.update and the production controllers. Site changes are separate labelled
clips. Regional effects use capture_regional_audio.Recorder's accepted-source
PCM/gain stream; this is offline rendering, not a recording of a live device.
Music is muted. No normalization, playback acceleration or replacement art.

markers.label: North checkpoint: initial witness position; production E starts the finite scene
guard_seat_action: Continue restores the same scene action and feet
Walk south to cancel an unread line without acknowledging it
Return on foot; E resumes the same missing line
Repeated E beside the walking guard remains owned by the active scene
Borrower seated; the other guard checks stores while keeping watch
Complete return: both original guards back at their duty positions
A later E visit uses the quieter two-line repeat
